independent_status_audit.review_method: Read complete extracted text of all 12 pages of 18September announcement and sole 30September page. Visually inspected rendered September 18 PDF pages 6 and 11 to verify current-status paragraph and exact property definitions. Original capture SHA256 hashes verified.
common_findings: September 18 is the current issuer disclosure date. The current-tense statements on page 6 support September 18 observations; the March 31 financial-year headings below that paragraph do not date its construction statements.

Page 2 ties Agreement – iTech 3.1 to Property 1 and Agreement – iTech 3.2 to Property 2. Page 9 identifies the agreement parties and defines Buyer as Amazon Data Services Hong Kong Limited. Page 11 supplies exact street addresses.

Page 1 describes conditional sale agreements, page 4 requires regulatory/other conditions and shareholder approval and gives February 26, 2027 as the initial target closing date. Page 9 explicitly says either or both disposals may not proceed. No completed ownership transfer is established.
The September 30 successor postpones the shareholder circular to on or before October 26, 2026. It supplies no newer physical-status observation and does not close the transaction.

The issuer announcement index captured October 25 lists September 30 as its newest transaction-related announcement. Its October 2 entry is a routine monthly securities return. Bounded English/Chinese searches through October 25 found no later transaction completion or physical-status successor.
The properties are commercial data-centre developments held for leasing. Do not infer owned-by-Amazon or current Amazon occupancy for Property 2.

sandy_ridge_audit.date_semantics: Date of government report of achieved construction; not an exact construction-start day, site-inspection day, completion or opening.
sandy_ridge_audit.identity_review: The 21 October report names Sandy Ridge Data Facility Cluster. The already-selected 2 March government tender result identifies that cluster as DD 89 Lot 953, awarded to Hong Kong Range Intelligent Computing Technology Company Limited. It is the same existing campus and initial-build scope; no new site, phase or geometric change is warranted.
sandy_ridge_audit.commercial_scope_review: The government awarded this cluster to a Range group commercial company for industry-led development and operation. This is not a university or demonstration installation.

identity_chain: Grand Ming's 18 September 2026 filing, page 11, identifies Property 1 at 3 On Kui Street and Property 2 at 8 On Chuen Street.
LandsD's official Land Exchange Transactions map has an embedded FeatureCollection that matches those exact numbered addresses to FSSTL 289 and FSSTL 288 respectively.
CSDI LandInformation exact-name queries each return one LotCSUID; polygon queries using those exact keys each return one polygon.
Chosen points are planar centroids of polygons served explicitly in EPSG:4326, rounded to seven decimals; both points lie inside their polygons.

Separate native EPSG:2326 centroids transformed through LandsD's Geodetic Survey service agree within 1e-7 degrees. Both official transaction reference points also lie inside their corresponding polygons.
geometry_review.scope: Whole-lot locators; no assertion of surveyed building or data-hall footprints.
exclusions: The ALS query for 8 On Chuen Street did not match the exact address; no nearest-address fallback was used.
The ALS substation point at 3 On Kui Street is not selected.
Historical 2020 DD51 lot 4433 sections were superseded by 2023 land exchanges and are not used as current boundaries.
Grand Ming's 2026 annual report was captured for research but provides no parcel identifiers needed for the geometry chain.
limitations: CSDI publishes no parcel positional tolerance; agreement between coordinate transformations provides numerical corroboration, not survey accuracy.
Land-exchange dates and the broad industrial/godown use do not establish current data-centre construction or operation; the parent selects the 18 September filing for status.
